authority_notes.template_lookup_constraint: query.url or query.project is provider-enforced because the closed request-schema root does not admit anyOf.
authority_notes.systematic_request_body_required_repair: 196 body-bearing operations omit requestBody.required; all are admitted as required raw payloads.
authority_notes.hidden_retry_policy: No operation declares a hidden retry; non-2xx responses fail the step.

source_decision.reason: These are infrastructure control-plane, configuration, or agent-execution records rather than user-work tasks, notes, or projects. The live OpenAPI also provides no field-level work-entity proof suitable for a truthful Source projection.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The OpenAPI declares neither a server nor any authentication scheme.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Pin managed Pulumi Cloud to https://api.pulumi.com and use the separately hash-locked first-party REST guide for complete Authorization header authority.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The rendered REST guide HTML changes bytes between requests even when its visible authority text is unchanged.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keep https://www.pulumi.com/docs/reference/cloud-rest-api/ as the human reference, but generate only after byte/hash verification of its first-party shortcode source at the immutable pulumi/docs commit in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pulumi/docs/4fd0c5118c6c909fcc2209e1d0b76308c2cac50c/layouts/shortcodes/cloud-rest-api-intro.html.

audit_findings_folded.finding: All 196 documented request bodies omit requestBody.required, including endpoints whose prose says the body is mandatory.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Require one bounded verbatim body_raw payload for every body-bearing operation and record the systematic repair per operation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Four template routes omit their documented url or project query inputs, and package usage omits packageName requiredness.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Repair six query contracts from operation prose plus explicit 400 descriptions; expose both template selectors and document the provider-enforced url-or-project condition because the closed request-schema root cannot encode it.

audit_findings_folded.finding: HEAD and text/event-stream cannot be represented faithfully by the current REST composition runtime.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Exclude exactly five active HEAD operations and one SSE operation with method-preserving reasons; never substitute GET or buffer an unbounded event stream.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Several reads and control-plane handshakes return decrypted secrets, minted update tokens, VCS webhook secrets, deployment credentials, logs, or agent content.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keep every mutation approval-gated, scan nested response schemas for credential fields, label secret-capable responses, and exclude those routes from bundled workflows. Reads carry no approval gate per D-209 §4: a mark true of every read carries no sensitivity signal, so containment rests on the secret-response label and the workflow exclusion rather than on a uniform prompt.

audit_findings_folded.finding: A keyword-only risk pass can understate stack, deployment, VCS, ESC, cloud-setup, agent, and credential-minting mutations as ordinary admin writes.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Classify every mutation in those high-impact families, plus every credential-bearing mutation, as destructive while retaining approval on all operations.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The initially selected GetStack workflow can return deprecated encryptedKey and encryptionSalt configuration fields.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Retain GetStack as a direct operation, classify it as secret-capable from schema fields, and replace its bundled workflow with the non-secret organization role-scope catalog.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Pulumi exposes JSON, YAML, text, Markdown, tar, empty, and mixed response contracts.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Select media explicitly, accept mixed JSON/text shapes, preserve JSON integers losslessly, and isolate tar bytes as file_ref.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Four active Registry operations document no 2xx response at all.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Retain the callable methods and paths without inventing a success body schema; non-2xx responses still fail.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Paging vocabulary is inconsistent and some response shapes would lose meaningful siblings if flattened.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Automate only exact request-token/response-token/collection or page-number contracts; retain all other controls and name the single-response limitation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The same docs mention self-hosted installations with tenant-specific API origins.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keep this family exact-host managed-only. A self-hosted family needs separate exact-host enrollment rather than per-call origin authority.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Stacks, projects, environments, and agent tasks resemble work entities by name but not semantics.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declare no work_entity_sources and preserve them only as explicit control-plane operations.
